response.sql: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS avg_line_total FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(lt.total_cost) AS avg_qualifying_total, COALESCE(SUM(lt.expense_count), 0) AS total_expenses, AVG(lt.total_cost - baseline.avg_line_total) AS avg_excess FROM line_totals AS lt CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE lt.total_cost > baseline.avg_line_total;
